en.content: A light whose electric field vectors are completely removed by using a good polaroid, allowed to incident on the surface of the prism at Brewster's angle. Choose the most suitable option for the phenomenon related to the prism.

options.content: Reflected and refracted rays will be perpendicular to each other.
Wave will propagate along the surface of prism.
No refraction, and there will be total reflection of light.
No reflection, and there will be total transmission of light.

en.explanation: When electric field vector is completely removed and incident on Brewster's angle then only refraction takes place.
